characters.name: MARI
characters.description: Väike inimene, tüdruk, heledad lühikesed juuksed, suured sinised silmad, seljas kollane pluus ja sinised traksipüksid. Sõbralik ja rõõmsameelne. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: KALLE
characters.description: Väike inimene, poiss, pruunid lühikesed juuksed, suured rohelised silmad, seljas roheline särk ja pruunid lühikesed püksid. Uudishimulik ja mänguhimuline. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Lastetuba
locations.description: Cozy children's playroom with light blue walls and a warm wooden floor. A large, low wooden table is in the center with two small wooden chairs. A window on the back wall shows green trees and a bright sunny sky outside. A small red toy box sits in one corner. Warm, bright light fills the room. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Mari and Kalle are in their cozy playroom. Mari is sitting on a small wooden chair at a low wooden table, looking thoughtfully. Kalle is standing next to the table, looking around the room. The room has light blue walls, a wooden floor, a window showing green trees and sunny sky, and a red toy box in the corner. Warm, bright light fills the room. Both characters have friendly, thoughtful expressions. Cartoon style.

Mari and Kalle are in their cozy playroom. Mari is sitting on a small wooden chair at a low wooden table, pointing at the plain light blue wall with a thoughtful expression. Kalle is standing next to her, looking at the wall with a curious expression. The room has light blue walls, a wooden floor, a window showing green trees and sunny sky, and a red toy box in the corner. Warm, bright light fills the room. Cartoon style.

Warm, bright light fills the room. Cartoon style.

The box of colorful pencils is on the table between them. The room has light blue walls, a wooden floor, a window showing green trees and sunny sky. Warm, bright light fills the room. Cartoon style.

Mari and Kalle are in their cozy playroom. Both are sitting on small wooden chairs at the low wooden table, actively drawing with various colorful pencils. Mari and Kalle are in their cozy playroom. Both are sitting on small wooden chairs at the low wooden table. They are holding up their finished, brightly colored drawings. The room has light blue walls, a wooden floor, a window showing green trees and sunny sky. Warm, bright light fills the room. Cartoon style.

Mari and Kalle are in their cozy playroom. Mari is standing on a small wooden chair, carefully taping her drawing of a sun to the light blue wall. The room has light blue walls, a wooden floor, a window showing green trees and sunny sky. Warm, bright light fills the room. Cartoon style.

Mari and Kalle are in their cozy playroom, standing together and admiring their finished drawings on the light blue wall. Mari's sun drawing and Kalle's butterfly drawing are clearly visible on the wall. Both children are smiling brightly, feeling proud and happy. The room now looks more colorful and joyful. The wooden table, chairs, and red toy box are in their usual places. The window shows green trees and sunny sky. Warm, bright light fills the room. Cartoon style.
